summary: The proposed patch addresses the UnboundLocalError by adding `raise NotImplementedError` in the `evalf_mul` function, but it may not fully resolve all edge cases and could be improved for clarity.

issues.description: The patch adds `raise NotImplementedError` for non-number cases, which might not cover all edge cases and could lead to unexpected behavior for other types of expressions.
The added `raise NotImplementedError` statements could be made more descriptive to clarify why these cases are not implemented.
